working: Running. The scenes appear when the run finishes.
mysql: Simulation scenes for MySQL are not in this version yet. Switch to PostgreSQL to see them.

schema.none: The SQL that just ran created no tables in the public schema, so there is nothing to draw.
schema.evidence: Read from the database that just ran, not from the SQL text: {count, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}}.

plan.noSelect: The SQL that just ran has no SELECT statement, so there is no plan to show.
plan.joinNote: This is a small illustrative sample of the join steps, not your data. The animation only plays when you press play.
plan.joinMore: {count} more join nodes in the plan have no animation shown.

btree.none: The schema has no index to read yet, so there is no tree to draw. Create an index (for example CREATE INDEX) and run again.
btree.pick: Choose an index to read its real tree.
btree.keyLabel: Key to drop down the tree
btree.keyHint: Leave it empty to only draw the tree. The key must match the type of the index's first column.

whatif.noSelect: The SQL that just ran has no SELECT statement to measure, so there is nothing to try a fix on.

capacity.none: The schema has no index to measure yet, so there are no Capacity numbers. Create an index (for example CREATE INDEX) and run again.
capacity.pick: Choose an index to see levels, size and pages read as data grows.
capacity.probe: Probe query: SELECT number {n}, the one you are viewing.
capacity.noProbe: The SELECT you are viewing does not read table {table}, so pages read are not measured. Levels and size are still measured.
capacity.noSelect: The SQL that just ran has no SELECT, so pages read are not measured. Levels and size are still measured.

mentor.noSelect: The SQL that just ran has no SELECT to ask about, so Mentor has no evidence yet.
mentor.invite: AI Mentor needs you to sign in. The SQL you are editing and your question are kept when you come back.
mentor.planNote: The evidence sent contains only SELECT number {n} and its plan, no data rows.
